run_vis_gt_poses: run the script to visualize ground-truth object poses for a BOP dataset like lm or hot3d
run_vis_gt_poses_hot3d: run the script with dataset set to hot3d to visualize hand tracking ground-truth poses
run_vis_gt_poses_subset: run the script with scene_ids and im_ids to visualize GT poses for a subset of images
run_vis_gt_poses_depth_diff: run the script with vis_depth_diff enabled to render depth difference images alongside RGB
run_vis_gt_poses_targets: run the script with a targets_filename to visualize GT poses only for specified estimation targets
